title: Grand Opening
morning_note: Grand opening! Listen for hint words, then pick 2 ingredients.

title: Word Gets Around
morning_note: Honeycomb and moonmoss in stock. Moonmoss must be ground in the mortar.

title: The Guild Comes Calling
morning_note: A Guild inspector is in town. Five new potions on the menu. Brew neatly!

lines.great: Calm, clear and correct. Your shop passes stage one.
lines.refused: Refusing the Guild? That goes in the file.
lines.stormed_off: Late. The Guild does not wait. Stage one: failed.

lines.great: Oh! The tickle's gone. Thank you... I'll remember this.
lines.poor: Still tickly... ahh... sorry about the smoke.
lines.stormed_off: I... I have to go. Ahh... AHH... sorry!

title: Rival Across the Street
morning_note: Cinderroot is in! Pump the bellows to wake its fire. Who opened that shop?

morning_notes.text: Cinderroot is in! Pump the bellows. A hooded stranger has been praising you.

lines.great: Hm! Not bad, neighbour. Not bad at all. Watch your back.
lines.poor: As I thought. Customers will flock to me. Ta-ta!
lines.refused: Too scared to brew for me? Delightful. Ciao!
lines.stormed_off: I waited. I never wait. You'll pay for that.

title: Market Day Rush
morning_note: Market day! More customers, less patience. Brew fast, smile faster.

morning_notes.text: Market day! The inspector speaks well of you. Brew fast, smile faster.
Market day rush! Word is the Guild inspector is coming back. Look sharp.

lines.great: Even in a rush, flawless. I'm recommending you.
lines.poor: Rushed. The fire won, the cool head lost. Noted.
lines.refused: Refusing an audit mid-rush. Bold. Recorded.
lines.stormed_off: Market day is no excuse. Audit failed.

lines.great: Much better. I'll amend the file. In pen.
lines.poor: Still shaky. My report grows longer.
lines.refused: No second chance taken? So be it.
lines.stormed_off: I waited. The Guild does not wait twice.

title: Rare Goods
morning_note: Rare goods at the market: snowfire pearls, twilight blooms and starlight dew.

morning_notes.text: Smoke over Vexley's shop! Rare goods at market: pearls, blooms, dew.
Vexley tells everyone you're a fraud. Rare goods at market today.

lines.great: No sparks! You kept my secret AND my fire. Friend!
lines.poor: It flickers still... but you didn't run. Thank you.
lines.refused: I see... a dragon is too much. I understand.
lines.stormed_off: Never mind... I shouldn't have said anything.

lines.great: Better... Maybe I'll tell you my secret one day.
lines.poor: Still tickly. I'd better keep my hood up.
lines.stormed_off: I'll go... before something catches fire.

lines.great: You saved my shop. Truce? Truce. Don't get used to it.
lines.poor: It fizzled. Well... thank you for trying. I suppose.
lines.refused: Fine! I'll fix it alone. Like always.
lines.stormed_off: Never mind! I'll find someone who answers the door.

lines.great: You... did it? Hmph. Perhaps I misjudged you.
lines.poor: Ha! I knew it. See you at the Fair, amateur.
lines.refused: Chicken! I'll tell the whole Fair.
lines.stormed_off: Too slow, darling! The Fair will hear of this.

title: The Guild Fair
morning_note: The Guild Fair! Everyone you've met is here. The licence is decided today.

morning_notes.text: The Guild Fair! Inspector Quill hints that your licence looks likely.

lines.great: The crowd adores it! Partners? Partners, darling!
lines.poor: Hm, the crowd's lukewarm. Next year, partner.
lines.refused: You'd leave our stall empty? Oh. I see.
lines.stormed_off: The stall's closing! Where's my showpiece?

lines.great: You win, darling. Rivals... and maybe friends?
lines.poor: Victory is mine! Still... thanks for the duel.
lines.refused: Forfeit! The duel goes to Vexley! Hmph.
lines.stormed_off: No-show? Then I win by default. Boring.

lines.great: The lanterns glow and the tent is fine! I'm a hero!
lines.poor: One lantern lit... and a small tent. Mostly fine.
lines.refused: Oh. I'll just watch from the hill, then.
lines.stormed_off: Too many people... I'll fly home.

lines.great: Phew! No sneezes! I even danced. Badly.
lines.poor: Ah... AHH... the Guild tent is a bit toasty now.
lines.refused: Then I'd better leave before I... ahh...
lines.stormed_off: AHH-CHOO! Oh no. Oh no. I'm so sorry!

lines.great: Balanced. Perfect. By Guild authority: licence granted!
lines.poor: So close. The Guild cannot grant a licence for close.
lines.refused: You refuse the final test? Then no licence.
lines.stormed_off: The judges leave. No potion, no licence.

lines.great: Against the odds: splendid! Licence granted!
lines.poor: Not enough, I'm afraid. No licence this year.
lines.refused: No potion, no licence. I'm sorry.
lines.stormed_off: Time's up. The Guild's verdict: no licence.
